embeds.title: [goodix-fp-linux-dev/goodix-firmware] New comment on issue #1: Use different firmware for each device
embeds.description: The check that triggers the flashing verifies the version reported by the microcontroller. embeds.title: [goodix-fp-linux-dev/goodix-firmware] New comment on issue #1: Use different firmware for each device
embeds.description: No, because dual booting would trigger the regeneration of the PSK, but it would not change the version string reported by the microcontroller.

embeds.title: [goodix-fp-linux-dev/goodix-firmware] New comment on issue #1: Use different firmware for each device

embeds.title: [goodix-fp-linux-dev/goodix-firmware] New comment on issue #1: Use different firmware for each device
embeds.description: No, it is not required. The "whitebox" encryption is obviously the same, but the PSK is flashed in a separate region. If the SHA256 of the PSK does not match the expected one, a new PSK is generated, sent whitebox encrypted and flashed on the microcontroller.
